edges.carries: the full text of the notice
the payee, amount, account, and due date the notice states
the validated payment details and any flagged problems
the user's approval and the approved payment details
the user's decision to decline, when no payment is made
the payment result and confirmation reference

nodes.name: ExtractInstructions
nodes.role: pull out the payment instructions the notice states, including payee, amount, account, and due date

nodes.name: ValidateInstructions
nodes.role: check that the extracted instructions are complete and consistent, and flag any that are missing details or conflict with each other

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: ask the user to approve the validated payment details before any money moves

nodes.name: ExecutePayment
nodes.role: make the payment the user approved, using the payee, amount, and account the instructions state

nodes.name: ReportOutcome
nodes.role: report to the user whether the payment succeeded, failed, or was not made
